invariants.rationale: If cell is not null and execution reaches this point, cell.getTile() must not be null to pass the null check.
If cell is not null, then cell.getTile() must not be an AnimatedTiledMapTile, or the method would have returned earlier.
Combined: If cell is not null, cell.getTile() must not be null or animated at this point.
If cell is not null and execution continues, cell.getTile().getTextureRegion() must be non-null for rendering.
Ensures the method returns early if the tile is animated; at this exit, this is not the case.
